metaDescription: See how an EasyGo Spa home massage looks — at home, in a condo or in your hotel room across Metro Manila.
title: Home Massage, Wherever You Are
lead: A look at how a session comes to you — at home, in a condo or in your hotel room.

home.title: At Your Home
home.alt: The EasyGoSpa green bag, folded towels and a stoneware bowl on a bench at the foot of a bed at home

condo.title: At Your Condo
condo.alt: The EasyGoSpa green bag on a condo sofa, with folded towels, an oil bottle and olive branches on the side table

hotel.title: In Your Hotel Room
hotel.alt: The EasyGoSpa green bag and folded towels at the foot of a hotel bed at dusk, city lights outside the window

thai.title: Thai Massage
thai.alt: A cotton-wrapped herbal compress on a folded towel, with lemongrass and an olive sprig

kit.title: Everything in One Bag
kit.alt: The EasyGoSpa green bag, folded towels, an oil bottle and an olive sprig on a wooden sideboard in late-afternoon light

stones.title: Warm Stones
stones.alt: Three warm dark massage stones on a folded towel, one resting in a brass dish

ready.title: Ready to Come to You
ready.alt: A folded EasyGoSpa uniform on top of the green bag by the door, ready to go

shiatsu.title: Shiatsu, No Oil
shiatsu.alt: Three folded towels tied with an olive cotton tape, no oil needed

oil.title: Aromatherapy Oils
oil.alt: Two essential-oil bottles and a bowl of oil with floating olive leaves, beside an olive branch

ctaText: Book now and your therapist comes to your home, condo or hotel. Pay in cash when they arrive.
